_comment: PLAN-AUTOSERVICE item 6 (docs/progress/autoservice-release.md, 2026-11-11): optional sidecar read by tools/server/make_base_json.py next to tools/maps/autoservice.json. OFFLINE DRAFT, not walked on the host yet: the first Autoservice raid must confirm every point with uibridge_teleport dryRun=true. Autoservice is Catalog-only until the lock-step promotion. Player spawns are the world positions of four of the 20 pocket markers of tools/maps/autoservice.modes.json (all 'Usec house' markers; the sides below are the plain raid's faction split, copied from Bowl, and a guess): (1) (All) and (4) (Usec) in the east pocket SPAWN_BOUND_Fighter (x -344..-333, z 476..508, yaw 270) and (6) (Bear) and (14) (All) in the west pocket SPAWN_BOUND_Fighter (1) (x -410..-405, z 476..502); the other 16 markers stay unused until ArenaMode places teams. Each row keeps 1.7 to 3.9 m of border clearance in Arena's own NavMesh. Bot spawns come from the AI scene (tools/maps/autoservice.ai.json): its 7 core points and the 16 born points (the SpawnPointMarkers 'p1', five in each pocket and six in the yard). Rule, as Iceberg's: no bot spawn within 10 m of a gate (the closed-to-open swept volume of the four gates) or of a pocket marker, and none within 10 m of an exit box centre, so the 10 pocket born points (0.5 to 4.3 m from a pocket marker) and born points 12 and 13 (8.2 and 7.5 m from the east big gate) are not used. Rows keep at least 1.35 m of border clearance in Arena's mesh: core 1 (0.87 m), core 3 (0.96 m), core 4 (1.15 m) and born point 0 (0.92 m) move 0.56 to 1.95 m onto open floor (1.5 to 1.6 m), a spot within 3.5 m with 1.5 m does not exist for core 6 (0.83 m, also 9.0 m from the east big gate) and born points 7 and 8 (0.54 and 0.55 m), which are dropped. Born point 1 (1.8 m from born point 0) is a duplicate and is dropped; the other rows stand on their point. The y of every row is Arena's NavMesh surface at the point (the core point's own within 0.02 m). That leaves 7 rows: cores 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and born point 0; all lie on Arena's 1,915.6 m2 main component. The south-east of the yard (x > -370, z < 480) has no bot spawn (core 6 and born points 12 and 13 are beside the east big gate). Waves and PMC boss waves copied from airpit.bots.json (Equator's). No loot, no scav raids. 2026-11-12 (user request: more spawn points, a recommendation of the ArenaMode session; offline numbers; host-checked on GPU-2 2026-11-12 (docs/progress/spawn-rows-and-pocket-exits.md): every appended row accepted by uibridge_teleport dryRun (path complete), BotZone.Init markers=16 onNavMesh=16; not checked: bots spawning at each new row): nine Bot rows are APPENDED after the seven above, which stay byte-identical (rule R1: existing rows never move; ArenaMode pins core-03 by id and floats; no new id starts with 'arena_autoservice-tdm-v1-'). Why: ArenaMode's burst selector uses only Bot rows at least 25 m (3D) from the player (Tactical needs five such rows from wherever the leader stands, Deathmatch, Gun Game and Zombies one, pickups at least six usable rows); the 7 rows left 5.6 % of the yard's NavMesh cells with no such row and only 23.5 % with five, the yard centre was a dead patch. With 16 rows 98.3 % of the main component's cells outside the pockets have five distant rows, 100 % have two, the fewest is 3 (24 cells in the yard centre, x -380..-369, z 484..496 keep 3 or 4). The nine rows: bot-lasthero-04, -13, -03 and -10 are Arena's LastHero (free-for-all) markers 'Usec house (4)', '(13)', '(3)' and '(10)' of Arena_AutoService_LastHero_DesignStuff, moved 0.995, 0.5, 0.505 and 0.503 m (xz) onto open floor (the markers were authored against a 0.28 m agent); bot-core-06 is Arena's AI core point 6 moved 1.0 m (the 2026-11-11 rule had skipped it, 9.0 m from the east big gate); bot-fill-01 to -04 are mesh fill points (no Arena source) on a 2 m lattice with 1.6 to 2.0 m of clearance. Every appended row lies on the 1,915.6 m2 main component with 1.37 m or more of border clearance on the built mesh (fill points 1.63 to 1.97 m; Arena's own mesh gives 1.32 to 1.35 m for three LastHero rows), passes spawn_placement_probe and stands on the surface within 0.04 m. Rule R5 for the appended rows (the yard is 58 m long and a row 25 m from a player in its centre must stand at the yard's ends, so the 2026-11-11 conventions above cannot hold for them; they stay valid for the original seven): at least 2.5 m from the swept footprint of a gate (not 10 m), at least 1.5 m outside both spawn bounds (not 5 m), at least 5 m from every Player row (not 10 m) and at least 4 m from every other Bot row; the decided rows keep 2.79 m, 2.67 m, 9.63 m and 6.0 m, and at least 7.0 m from every pocket marker (the least is 8.0 m; the 10 m marker convention above is weakened to 7.0 m, not to the gate figure). Two clauses of the 2026-11-11 text above no longer hold and are retired: 'none within 10 m of an exit box centre' (rule R3: the exits now stand inside the pockets, and every row keeps 2.5 m to a box EDGE instead, see autoservice.exits.json), and 'the south-east of the yard (x > -370, z < 480) has no bot spawn' (bot-core-06 at x -352.47, z 478.73 and bot-fill-02 at x -360, z 476 now stand there).
